author: Huawei
description:
Every generation of wireless technology has an origin story, one shaped by breakthroughs and pioneers. Episode 1 of Huawei's Signals of Change revisits the early days of 3G and an innovation that changed how wireless networks were built: the distributed base station. Discover how Huawei engineers helped transform mobile connectivity.

Learn more about Signals of Change, produced by #Huawei and CNN International's brand studio Create: https://bit.ly/4zaxI9J #Antennas #InnovateForImpact
title: Small Station, Giant Leap: How the World Was Connected
